'''Mynock''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], he went on a secret undercover assignment until he was killed by several Republic traitors. Eventually, his partner [[Firehawk (Kadas'sa'Nikto)|Firehawk]] sent a spacer to recover his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="TOR" />
